A non-volatile key is treated as an infinite TTL for the purpose of GT and LT . The GT , LT and NX options are mutually exclusive.

cases.query: JavaScript Object.freeze shallow nested object mutation strict mode TypeError
cases.criteria: Object.freeze is shallow: the frozen object own properties cannot be changed, while a nested referenced object remains mutable unless separately frozen. Strict mode throws TypeError for a prohibited frozen-object mutation; it does not make nested objects recursively frozen.

gold.basis: concrete requested relationship and material conditions in inspected retained source

support.quote: Freezing an object prevents extensions and makes existing properties non-writable and non-configurable.
function fail() { "use strict"; obj.foo = "sparky"; // throws a TypeError
If the value of those properties are objects themselves, those objects are not frozen and may be the target of property addition, removal or value re-assignment operations.
